phase_name: Appendix numbering and the reference show-rule

objectives.description: Rewrite #show ref rule to read el.supplement/el.numbering with el.numbering==none fallback
Give Lean appendix title heading real appendix identity (Appendix A)
Give machine appendix title heading Appendix B identity and B.n section numbering
Confirm Lean appendix A.n section numbering unchanged
Update stale appendix-title link in p4-dataset-pipeline.typ

approaches_tried.approach: Real Typst letter-numbering for the appendix title headings (supplement 'Appendix', numbering function rendering 'A'/'B'), rather than the literal-title-text fallback, with counter(heading).update(0) reset before the Lean appendix title and natural auto-increment carrying the machine appendix to letter B
approaches_tried.reason: Verified in an isolated scratch reproduction before touching real files: TOC shows 'A ...'/'B ...' with A.n/B.n subsections, @-references render 'Appendix A'/'Appendix B', ordinary chapter references are unaffected, and no raw-counter concatenation occurs (root cause: counter(heading).at(location) returns a multi-component array once any level-2 heading has been seen, and a single-placeholder numbering pattern concatenates extra components with no separator -- exactly the observed 'Chapter 1534' bug). The el.numbering == none branch renders by el.body as a defensive fallback for any future unnumbered level-1 heading, never by re-attempting the raw counter.

approaches_tried.approach: Plain #set heading(supplement: "Appendix") to override the document-wide show-set rule for supplement
approaches_tried.reason: A #show heading.where(...): set heading(...) rule (declared once at document start) wins over a later plain #set for the same field; had to use the same show-set rule TYPE (#show heading.where(level:1): set heading(supplement: "Appendix")) positioned after the document-wide one to override it for the appendices onward
